description: Contract for the Construction of the Courts Complex at Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to award the above contract at a cost of Rs.513 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC) was approved by the Cabinet.
